author: reek
body: ProcessEngine's parse-int read ASCII digit codes in a CCE world, so it returned 0 for every number it was given. Nothing caught it because the only callers are the GreaterThan and LessThan gate conditions, and a gate that compares 0 against its threshold still answers True or False. It just answers the same one every time.

author: reek
body: The value lines are the test. A gate line alone would not be, since both a working parse and a broken one produce a Boolean.
